name: TRAIN_NLL
definition: Negative log-likelihood of the model's own DEVELOPMENT data under itself
scoring_unit: model-dependent (GLYPH for G1-only, TOKEN for G2/G3)
notes: Sanity/convergence check only; task85 section 23 forbids using training likelihood alone for any verdict

name: HELDOUT_NLL
definition: Sum of -log2 P(observed unit | model) over the frozen HELDOUT partition
scoring_unit: GLYPH for G1-only models scored at glyph level; TOKEN for G2/G3
notes: Core predictive quantity; must use the model's own smoothing/back-off, no oracle assistance

name: CROSS_ENTROPY
definition: PM1 divided by the number of scored units, in bits
notes: Common currency for cross-model-class comparison per scored unit

name: PERPLEXITY
notes: Meaningful only when comparing models scored at the same unit (task85 section 23 "perplexity where meaningful"); otherwise report CROSS_ENTROPY per GLYPH as the common currency instead

name: UNSEEN_TOKEN_PROBABILITY
definition: Mean predictive probability the model's own smoothing/back-off assigns to HELDOUT TOKENs absent from DEVELOPMENT
notes: Operationalizes task85 section 35 ("assign probability to unseen valid-like forms"); no oracle-assisted smoothing

name: PREDICTIVE_CALIBRATION
definition: Bucketed calibration error (reliability-diagram style) between predicted probability bucket and observed HELDOUT frequency
notes: Guards task85 section 31 ("high likelihood alone insufficient")

name: NEGATIVE_DISCRIMINATION_AUC
definition: ROC AUC discriminating HELDOUT observed TOKENs from matched NEGATIVE_TOKEN_CONTROLS (GRAMMAR_VALIDATION_CONTRACT.md section on negative controls), using the model's own likelihood as score
notes: Operationalizes task85 section 35's discrimination test and section 36's negative-token protocol
